Hi Mina / Priyom,

Thanks again for the quick onboarding call yesterday — excited to get CedarBay live with Redwood for the pilot. Per our discussion, attaching our standard bank letter and a signed W-9 so your payments team can complete vendor enrollment. Highlights below: 

- Account name: CedarBay Systems, Inc.
- Bank: First Harbor Bank
- ACH Routing: 021000021
- ACH Account (last 4): ••43
- Wire routing (Fedwire): 021000021
- Beneficiary reference: CedarBay Systems / Invoice #

We prefer ACH for recurring payments; wire for one-off international transfers. Please confirm what fields you need on the PO/invoice so our AP team can align — we currently include: PO number, Redwood invoice reference, ship-to code, and ledger tag.

Attachments: [cedarbay_bank_letter.pdf (PDF, 145 KB)], [cedarbay_w9_signed.pdf (PDF, 72 KB)], [cedarbay_ach-and-wire-instructions.pdf (PDF, 28 KB)]

Let me know if you need a micro-deposit verification step or additional bank attestation.

Subject: Re: CedarBay banking credentials and PO routing for Redwood engagement

Thanks Sanjay — this is helpful. A few quick clarifying items from FinOps side: 

1) Can you confirm the EIN on the W-9 matches CedarBay legal name exactly (we need exact match for vendor record)? If you can paste the EIN in the reply that saves a step.
2) For ACH verification we typically do two $0.05 micro-deposits (we run these within 48 hours of receiving bank details). Is that acceptable for CedarBay?
3) PO mapping: we require a single invoice field called "invoice_reference" and an optional "cost_center" tag. Can the invoice you send include the PO number and a short description (<= 65 chars)? I attached our PO field spec for easy reference.

Also looping Ben on routing formats — Ben, can you confirm whether the last 4 account digits we see (••43) line up with our micro-deposit test (if we run it) or if you prefer bank-letter validation only for this vendor?

Appreciate the quick turn here — aim to have CedarBay in the vendor registry before next Friday's pay-run.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Vendor Onboarding Specialist
Redwood Inference
[attachment: PO-field-mapping-spec.pdf]
